title: TAGE 模块闭环：恢复已知缺陷的严格 XFAIL（修复误报 FAIL），并逐项归因 120 行 / 85 arm
status: module-loop-closed-for-current-RTL; BPU-TAGE-026 remains the documented strict XFAIL
scope: 独立 Tage DUT 的 36 个功能点与 227 个选测用例；不证明完整 BPU 或完整 FTQ

human_events.event: 同一 bank 的四条真实 PC 在双向 provider-way 迁移后接受新鲜反馈；邻居 tag 的目标、计数与 useful 必须各自保持。
human_events.owner: 新鲜反馈属于原预测的完整身份，不属于当前物理 way。

human_events.event: 重放原预测捕获的 provider-way metadata，让 tag 在迟到反馈前迁移。
human_events.owner: 迟到的 useful 更新可以丢弃或改向，但不能改变旧物理 way 上无关 tag 的 useful。
human_events.observed_difference: 迁移后的无关 tag useful 从 3 变 1；这是仓库已记录的 RTL 差异。

false_fail_repair.cause: The test is marked xfail(strict=True, raises=MisassociatedProviderUseful). After the independent semantic reference began comparing useful, it detects the same defect one boundary earlier and raises ScoreboardMismatch; with raises= set, pytest no longer matches the marker and reports an ordinary FAIL.
false_fail_repair.fix: bpuverify/tage/case/way_migration_scenario.as_misassociated_useful() re-labels only an all-`useful` difference set as MisassociatedProviderUseful. Any other mismatch returns None and the caller re-raises the original exception.
false_fail_repair.negative_control: tests/tage/scoreboard/test_way_migration_mismatch.py: useful-only becomes the declared defect; mixed, counter-only and empty difference sets are not re-labelled.
false_fail_repair.not_xfail_widening: the marker is still strict and still limited to the one declared exception; a non-useful mismatch would fail the suite

delta_vs_baseline.note: the repair changes verdicts, not native counts

uncovered_lines.meaning: Every line is one arm of the same per-slot register assignment emitted for each of the eight write-buffer slots. The source has a single semantic write per field; the duplicates come from several `when` blocks updating the same register and from the generated hit/not-hit priority tree.

WriteBuffer.dead_detail: writeTouchVec_{0,1}_bits = io_write_{0,1}_valid & ~hit ? victim : 2'h0 is generated inside the same if guard, so the else is unreachable

ram_4x9.reason: the only generated counter queue instance ties R0_en high

useAltOnNa_open_candidate.observed: the eight useAltOnNa counters show only their normal increment path; clamp-at-31 and subtract-to-zero arms are uncovered
useAltOnNa_open_candidate.why_single_pair_cannot_reach: with one provider/alternate pair a +1 step always moves the provider out of the weak band (3/4), and the next feedback that returns it to the weak band decrements the selector, so the counter oscillates near its weak-positive init instead of saturating
useAltOnNa_open_candidate.what_would_reach_it: a multi-slot t3 beat whose branches share one useAltOnNa index and request the same direction, so the RTL applies a step of two or more
useAltOnNa_open_candidate.disposition: open candidate, not claimed as PASS; no bank/set sweep and no internal writes

functional_groups.explanation: the captured mode retains its sixteen failing bins; the known RTL defect means those obligations earn reached but not checked credit

false_positive_false_negative_checks: The repair targets a false FAIL, not a false PASS: the same RTL difference remains reported, and any non-useful mismatch still fails normally.
The helper is covered by pure negative controls for mixed, counter-only and empty difference sets.
The strict marker is unchanged; a future fix that makes the scenario pass would XPASS and fail the strict expectation instead of silently passing.
Coverage is unchanged by the repair (4467/4587 lines), so no native growth is claimed for a verdict correction.
The 120 lines are grouped into eight write-buffer slots before being called replicas; they are not waved away as 'copy noise' without evidence.
constraints: No RTL, DUT or system SDK change.
No new XFAIL and no loss of strictness.
No internal signal writes or bank/set sweeps.
The selected run does not replace the retained full regression.
remaining: BPU-TAGE-026 remains a real RTL difference (captured provider way misassociating useful after tag migration).
The useAltOnNa clamp/subtract arms need a multi-slot same-index batch to be exercised; documented as an open candidate.
Full FTQ lifetime and composed BPU arbitration remain outside this module run.
